payload.title: Pilot lessons 1 to 4 with the student alone and measure before authoring the rest
payload.description: Instrument time per scene, idle over 60 s, hint rung and Show me use, prediction accuracy, resets, quit points, Next versus Stop, and an in-app too-easy/just-right/too-hard prompt plus one explain-back per lesson. Rule: if more than 20 percent of goals need rung 3 or Show me, or a lesson is abandoned twice, rewrite it first.
